reason: The plugin adds an @-mention picker that filters workspace files and directories, then inserts selected relative paths into the chat input for model-assisted file access.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中输入 @ 即可搜索并选择工作区文件或目录，将其相对路径插入消息以便模型引用。
summaries.en: Type @ in the chat input to search and select workspace files or directories, then insert their relative paths for model reference.

capabilities: Reads Git tracking and change status to filter workspace entries
Parses .gitignore and .aiinclude rules for file inclusion
Adds an @-mention file picker to the chat input
Inserts selected relative file or directory paths into chat input
